payload.title: Reject optimization approvals when frozen evidence changes
payload.description:
As a portfolio operator, I want a structured approval to authorize only the exact evidence shown to the reviewer, so that recomputed targets cannot inherit stale approval.

Feature: Frozen optimization approval evidence

Scenario: Evidence changes before procedure resume
  Given a pending optimization approval for an exact target and assessment fingerprint
  And the portfolio is recomputed with a different fingerprint, champion version, feedback watermark, or target set
  When the saved human response is reconciled
  Then the response does not approve the recomputed target
  And no optimizer is dispatched
  And a fresh approval remains required

Scenario: Evidence remains identical
  Given a pending optimization approval for an exact frozen target batch
  When the procedure resumes with a valid response and identical preconditions
  Then only that exact batch may be accepted.
